strings.{{observed}} у остановки чуть не провали: On {{observed}}, I nearly fell into an open manhole near the bus stop. The cover was still missing this morning. Children use this path to get to school. I was told: “The appeal will be examined within a month.” What should we do until then?
strings.Авторское учебное изложение проверенных: Author's training summary of verified provisions, not a website facsimile
strings.В Совет депутатов для назначения ремонта: To the Council of Deputies to order the repair
strings.В исходных историях про люк владелец сет: In the original manhole stories, the network owner is unknown; in the river stories, one photograph establishes neither pollution composition nor the supervision level. Assumptions cannot replace missing facts.
strings.В модели прошло два часа. Ответственный: Two hours have passed in the simulation. The responsible person reports: “The area has been cordoned off.” Sergey Petrovich sends an update: the barrier blocks the whole path and pedestrians are walking into the roadway.
strings.В разговоре установлено текущее состояни: The conversation established the current condition. The network’s affiliation cannot be inferred solely from its proximity to a residential building.
strings.В этой истории владелец ещё не установле: In this story the owner is still unidentified and the danger remains. Do not reuse the route from a variant with a confirmed operator or the conclusion that a repair is complete.
strings.Верно: срок рассмотрения и срок ремонта: Correct: the examination period and repair deadline are the same.
strings.Вернуться к опасному участку через месяц: Return to the dangerous location in a month.
strings.Временная мера не равна окончательному у: A temporary measure is not the final resolution. New circumstances need assessment; an intern does not direct the repair crew.
strings.Вчера позвонил в управляющую компанию. Н: I called the property management company yesterday. They gave me no request number. I don’t know who maintains this network.
strings.Выберите положение, обосновывающее прове: Select the provision that justifies checking competence and then forwarding the appeal. The general review period alone is not what is needed.
strings.Вымышленные служебные материалы симулято: Fictional official materials of the simulator
strings.Выполняйте действия в пределах своей рол: Act within your role. Independent actions may be performed in different orders.
strings.Выслушайте обращение и уточните факты. Н: Listen to the appeal and clarify the facts. The case title does not determine which actions are correct.
strings.Для решения о прекращении переписки учит: A decision to end correspondence takes account of repeated prior substantive replies, absence of new arguments or circumstances, and statutory conditions. Letter count alone is insufficient.
strings.Если решение вопросов не относится к ком: If the issues lie outside the recipient's powers, the written appeal is forwarded to the competent body or official and the citizen is notified. An address does not establish authority.
strings.Жалобу на решения и действия работника М: A complaint about a service centre employee's decisions and actions goes to that centre's director. Do not confuse a centre employee with the body providing the service.
strings.Жалобу на решения и действия самого МФЦ: A complaint about the service centre's own decisions and actions goes to its founding authority or an official authorised by a regulatory legal act of the constituent entity.
strings.Жалобу нельзя направить на рассмотрение: A complaint must not be referred for consideration to the body or official whose decision, action or inaction is challenged.
strings.За люк точно отвечает управляющая компан: The building’s property management company is definitely responsible for the manhole.
Close the case: the barrier is in place.
strings.Зафиксировать поступление; не откладыват: Record receipt without delaying the urgent notification.
strings.Источник подтверждает именно выбранное д: The source supports the specific action selected.
strings.К счастью, нет. Я только споткнулся и ус: Fortunately not. I only stumbled and managed to step back.
strings.Когда адресат ещё не установлен: When the recipient has not yet been identified
strings.Компетентный адресат будет установлен по: The competent recipient will be identified through verification. For now, calculate the latest date for referring the appeal to the competent body. This is not the deadline for eliminating the danger.
strings.Куда вы уже сообщали об этом?: Who have you already reported this to?
strings.Люк на пешеходной дорожке; принадлежност: The manhole is on a pedestrian path; the network’s affiliation has not yet been established.
strings.Материалы дела · реестр и ответ исполнит: Case materials · register and contractor's reply
strings.На момент разговора о пострадавших не из: At the time of the conversation, no injuries are known.
strings.На пешеходной дорожке открыт круглый кол: An open circular manhole is on the pedestrian path; there is no barrier nearby.
strings.Найденная страница заменяет проверку обс: The page found replaces verification of the facts of the case.
strings.Найдите норму и проверьте её применимост: Find the provision and check applicability. A click count cannot replace information from external sources.
strings.Найдите положение об обязательном уведом: Find the provision requiring notification of the citizen when a written appeal is referred to the competent body.
strings.Найти доски и устранить опасность своими: Find some boards and eliminate the danger yourself.
strings.Не назначать ответственного по одному вн: Do not assign responsibility on the basis of a single outward sign.
strings.Не обещать дату ремонта, которая ещё не: Do not promise a repair date that has not yet been confirmed.
strings.Нет. Двадцать минут назад сосед проходил: No. A neighbour passed by twenty minutes ago: the opening was uncovered, with no tape or barrier.
strings.Нет: срок ответа не заменяет оперативное: No: the reply deadline does not replace an urgent response to danger.
strings.Новый документ или снимок сопоставляют с: Compare a new document or photograph with the subject and date of the old reply. The same letter writer does not prove the issues are identical.
strings.Номер части статьи 8, обосновывающей нап: Number of the part of Article 8 that justifies forwarding according to competence
strings.Обращение по 59-ФЗ + оперативная передач: An appeal under 59-FZ plus prompt reporting of danger
strings.Общий срок рассмотрения не является унив: The general examination period is not a blanket postponement of action on a current danger.
strings.Общий срок рассмотрения письменного обра: The general written-appeal consideration period is tied to registration. It is not a universal deadline for construction, repairs or pollution removal.
strings.Объяснить заявителю ближайшие действия: Explain the immediate next steps to the applicant
strings.Одного формального ответа оказалось недо: A formal reply alone proved insufficient: the urgent information may not have reached the responsible person. Correct the unsafe plan before continuing the shift.
strings.Опасность не требует действий до окончан: No action on the danger is required until the reply deadline expires.
strings.Опасность сохраняется, принадлежность се: The danger remains; the network’s affiliation must be established.
strings.Опасный участок сейчас ограждён?: Is the dangerous area cordoned off now?
strings.Орган обеспечивает объективное, всесторо: The body ensures objective, comprehensive and timely consideration, requests materials where needed and provides a substantive reply. An appeal does not replace a budget decision.
strings.Оставить в приёмной до истечения общего: Leave it with reception until the general time limit expires
strings.Ответственному дежурному; далее профильн: To the responsible duty officer, then to the relevant operator once the network is identified
strings.Ответственный дежурный принял информацию: The responsible duty officer has received the hazard report. Identifying the network and preparing the referral route are proceeding in parallel. The repair date is not yet confirmed.
strings.Ответственный подтвердил, что сведения о: The responsible person confirmed receipt of the information about the diversion. Safe passage and replacement of the cover remain under follow-up.
strings.Официальное происхождение позволяет прим: An official origin allows the material to be applied to any issue.
strings.Передать сведения ответственному дежурно: Pass the information to the responsible duty officer now
strings.По учебному внутреннему регламенту – без: Under the training internal procedure, without waiting for the written reply.
strings.Подготовить направление по установленной: Prepare referral to the body with the established competence
strings.Подтверждённого исполнителя и номера зая: There is not yet a confirmed responsible operator or request number.
strings.Пока ограничиться стандартным письмом: For now, send only a standard letter
strings.Попросить жителей самостоятельно переста: Ask residents to move the barrier themselves.
strings.После принятия решения заявителю направл: After the decision, a reasoned reply must be sent to the applicant no later than the following day. This is a separate action, not a new full complaint consideration period.
strings.Поставить проверку обратной связи на кон: Keep receipt of feedback under follow-up
strings.Правило исчисления в этом учебном деле:: Calculation rule for this training case: exclude the triggering day. Count all calendar days; if the end falls on a non-working day, move it to the next working day. This profile is specified by the scenario and does not automatically apply to every procedure.
strings.Предложить жителю самому закрыть отверст: Suggest that the resident cover the opening themselves
strings.Предоставление государственной услуги че: Provision of a public service through a multifunctional centre
strings.При нескольких вопросах, относящихся к р: Where several issues belong to different bodies, copies of the appeal are forwarded to the appropriate recipients. Keep the issues distinguishable.
strings.При переадресации гражданина можно не ув: The citizen need not be notified when the appeal is referred.
strings.При переадресации по компетенции граждан: The citizen is notified when an appeal is referred to the competent body; this does not mean that the problem has already been resolved.
strings.При установленной текущей опасности отсу: No urgent notification was made despite an established current danger.
strings.Принято письменное обращение с контактам: A written appeal with contact details has been received. The exact location is marked on the attached training diagram. The date and personal signature are present. You are clarifying the circumstances; the passport and home address must not be published on the game board.
strings.Приёмная органа исполнительной власти Мо: Reception office of a Moscow executive authority
strings.Проверить регистрацию обращения и состав: Check registration of the appeal and the submitted materials
strings.Прошу принять меры из-за открытого люка: Please take action concerning the open manhole in section A. I enclose a diagram and a photograph. The appeal was received in writing today; the required contact details and signature were checked on receipt.
strings.С необходимыми материалами и уведомление: With the necessary materials and a notification of referral.
strings.Сначала установите событие и единицы счё: First identify the starting event and counting units, then find the exact date. The calendar does not choose the applicable law for you.
strings.Сообщение об ограждении само по себе не: A report that a barrier was installed does not itself prove that the route is safe. Follow-up was closed prematurely.
strings.Сразу только управляющей компании ближай: Immediately and exclusively to the nearest building’s property management company
strings.У остановки, на пешеходной дорожке. На с: Near the bus stop, on the pedestrian path. I marked section A on the diagram. It is not in the courtyard of our apartment building.
strings.Убедиться, что срочное сообщение принято: Make sure the responsible person has received the urgent information.
strings.Уведомление автоматически подтверждает з: The notification automatically confirms that the repair is complete.
strings.Уточнить безопасность обхода и передать: Check that the diversion is safe and pass the new information to the responsible person; keep the case under follow-up.
strings.Уточнить владельца сети и исполнителя: Clarify the network owner and the responsible operator
strings.Учебная модель. Принимаете обращение и г: Training model. You receive the appeal and draft referrals to the competent authority and notices. You may not exercise another authority’s powers.
strings.Учебное описание фотографии: на пешеходн: Training description of the photograph: an open manhole without a barrier on a pedestrian path. The image does not reveal the network’s affiliation. Time: today, 08:40. The photograph confirms the visible condition but does not establish the entity responsible for the asset.
strings.Часть 3 статьи 8 связывает направление о: Part 3 of Article 8 links forwarding an appeal to competence. Article 12 addresses a different issue: the review period. The network owner cannot be identified from the district's name.
strings.Электронный помощник: «По 59-ФЗ на ремон: Electronic assistant: “59-ФЗ allows 30 days for the repair, so there is no need to pass on any information before that period ends.”
